description: Zero-infrastructure, local-first memory for AI agents. One SQLite file — no Postgres, Neo4j, or cloud. Bi-temporal supersession (updates, never deletes), four-channel hybrid retrieval, and a drop-in MCP server. Runs offline on cheap models. Apache-2.0. Bring your own benchmark.
